mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.level, r.slot_no, r.status, r.chip_uid, a.handler1, a.handler2, a.occurred_at FROM reagent r LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT handler1, handler2, occurred_at FROM access_record WHERE reagent_id = r.id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) a ON true ORDER BY r.slot_no, r.id
SELECT id, chip_uid, name, level, slot_no, status, updated_at FROM reagent WHERE slot_no = #{slot} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reagent (chip_uid, name, level, slot_no, status, updated_at) VALUES (#{chipUid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{name}, #{level}, #{slotNo}, #{status}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE reagent SET chip_uid = #{chipUid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, name = #{name}, level = #{level}, slot_no = #{slotNo}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
